messages.subject: geom_line question
parts:
Hello users,

I am trying to use geom_line function. But, the how the line connects through dots is unexpected and also different from the the R plot function. Both function code and their results is below. I would appreciate if some explanations can be provided. Thanks a lot!

Codes are as follows:

plot(TT$CONC,TT$EFFECT,type="l")

ggplot(data=TT, aes(CONC, EFFECT)) +
  geom_line(colour="red")

Plot results are attached.

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: geom_line question
parts:
On 4/3/2013 1:02 PM, pharmpk wrote:
> Hello users,
>
> I am trying to use geom_line function. But, the how the line connects
> through dots is unexpected and also different from the the R plot function.
> Both function code and their results is below. I would appreciate if some
> explanations can be provided. Thanks a lot!
>
> Codes are as follows:
>
> plot(TT$CONC,TT$EFFECT,type="l")
>
> ggplot(data=TT, aes(CONC, EFFECT)) +
> geom_line(colour="red")
>
> Plot results are attached.

geom_line, per the description ("Connect observations, ordered by x
value") sorts the data in increasing x order before connecting the
points. From your other plot, it seems you want them connected in the
order that they appear in the data.frame TT. For that, use geom_path
("Connect observations in original order") instead.



--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University
